text:
jen_support: FYI — multiple support tickets from Acme Corp look like the same feature ask (they want tenant-level routing rules). Tickets #8452, #8491, #8503. Can we canonicalize?

arjun_pm: thanks Jen. do we have the customer impact / revenue ask on these?

jen_support: Acme says it's blocking their rollout next month. Ben on sales flagged as deal-impacting.

ben_sales: confirmed — renewal Q4, they'll delay if routing not possible. high commercial impact.

maria_eng: quick check — two of these are identical, third is slightly different (wants condition on token usage). i can sketch a dev effort estimate but need product prioritization.

arjun_pm: proposal: merge into one canonical request `CR-2026` with sublinks to the three tickets. Tag it with `duplicate/merged`, `priority:rev-impact`, `area:routing`. QA: do we need separate scope items for token-conditions?

jen_support: sounds good. please add "customer-facing status" field so support can ping them.

arjun_pm: agreed. i'll create CR-2026 and put a short scope doc. action items: (1) product to own canonicalization + scope, (2) eng to provide rough T-shirt estimate, (3) sales to confirm commercial slack window, (4) support to send initial comms.

maria_eng: ETA for rough estimate: end of day tomorrow. can we lock the acceptance criteria before dev?

arjun_pm: yes — acceptance criteria draft: 1) allow tenant routing rules with match on request metadata; 2) support simple token-usage condition (operators: >, <, ==); 3) config UI or API only? scope minimal: API first, Console tracked as follow-up.

ben_sales: API-first is fine for them. they'll accept a config-as-code workaround.

ops-bot: Deploy bot: created issue CR-2026 in product board by @arjun_pm.

jen_support: ok sending customer update draft. Posting here so product can approve: 
```
Hi <@Acme> — thanks for the reports. We're tracking this work under CR-2026 (tenant routing rules). We're merging your three reported tickets into that single request so we can prioritize effectively. Target: initial API support in the next quarter. We'll follow up with estimated ETA after internal scoping. If you have a specific rollout date, please share it and we'll factor into prioritization. 
Best, Jen (Redwood Support)
```

arjun_pm: edit: change "next quarter" to "next milestone" — don't overcommit. also add a line that we'll notify them when the ticket moves to in-progress.

jen_support: updated and sent. they responded :thumbsup:.

maria_eng: posted estimate stub: 3-5 wks eng + 1 wk QA for API-only MVP. i'll attach more detail to CR-2026.

arjun_pm: thank you. prioritization note: treat as P1 for customers flagged by sales as deal-impacting. otherwise P2. We'll surface in next triage on Monday.

ben_sales: noted. i'll update the renewal thread and ask for any hard dates.

jen_support: final check: tagging policy for merged requests — do we include the original ticket numbers in the canonical issue summary?

arjun_pm: yes please. format: "CR-2026 — merged: #8452, #8491, #8503". Also add a short rationale and which ticket is the primary reporter.

ops-bot: Reminder: weekly triage board review scheduled Mon 10:00am.

maria_eng: i added a short runbook for fallback behavior in case routing fails (auto-fallback to default tenant). dev note in CR-2026.

arjun_pm: great. i'll close the loop in triage and if all good we'll move to planning lane. thanks everyone.

jen_support: thanks — closing thread and leaving pointers in the merged ticket.
